name: map-arrow-fanout
title: Map Arrow Fanout
description: Berlin Airlift-style Germany map: west/east color grammar, Berlin pin and sectors, thick W-E arrow fan-out with glow trails, then endcard. Seek-safe SVG/GSAP; no MP4 wrapper. Inspired by Moving Image Archive Animated Maps (Germany / Berlin Airlift era footage) - not affiliated; code recreation. Fidelity ceilings: hotter glow vs film, sector purple-to-blue, faceted coasts, SVG endcard, Act1 color grammar, film grain.
